name: Creamy Black Bean Wraps with Sautéed Bell Peppers & Mango-Cabbage Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch cilantro
3 limes
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ mangoes
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a large bowl and half in a blender.
Juice half of the limes into the bowl with the cilantro; juice remaining limes into the blender and set aside.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the cilantro. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince shallots; add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and cumin; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; medium dice and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter each cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and add to the bowl. Stir to combine the slaw and set aside.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell peppers.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bell pepper and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; add to the blender with the cilantro and lime juice.
Peel garlic; add to the blender along with water, pumpkin seeds, and spices. Blend on high until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ cup water
¾ cup pumpkin seeds
1 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place tortillas on a flat surface and spread each with an even layer of black bean spread. Top with bell peppers and a small portion of slaw (reserving the rest for serving); roll tightly to close.
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates; serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!
